providerComparison.note: Event-level player-on-field targets are authoritative for model targets; provider boxscore values remain comparison fields. Team fouls are authoritative at team level; individual foul sums are not substituted when they differ.

targetDefinitions.yellowCards: Ordinary yellow-card key events assigned to athletes recorded as having appeared; includes a first yellow before a later second-yellow dismissal.
targetDefinitions.secondYellowCards: Red-card key events whose source text explicitly says Second yellow card.
targetDefinitions.directRedCards: Other red-card key events assigned to athletes recorded as having appeared.
targetDefinitions.totalCards: yellowCards + secondYellowCards + directRedCards. Provider boxscore yellow/red counts are retained separately and never substituted.
targetDefinitions.benchStaffPolicy: Events for rostered non-participants, staff or unresolved participants are excluded from individual/team/model targets and reported separately.
targetDefinitions.minutes: Derived after the match from starter, substitution and dismissal clocks (capped at 90/120, excluding added-time precision); outcome/exposure only, never a pre-match feature.

rules: Rolling features use only matches with kickoff strictly earlier than the current kickoff; simultaneous matches are updated as one batch.
Actual starters, appearances, substitutions and minutes are post-match outcome/exposure fields and never pre-match features.
The current match boxscore, events and player statistics are target data only.
Historical referee names identify the actual official, but no source publication timestamp proves when the designation became available; referee features are blocked for strict training.
Role metadata from the post-match roster is not admitted as a timestamp-verified feature.

baselineSpecifications.totalCardsNoReferee: Competition/season intercept plus strictly-prior home and away team disciplinary rates; referee identity and referee priors omitted.
baselineSpecifications.teamCardsNoReferee: Strictly-prior team and opponent disciplinary rates with venue indicator; referee omitted.
baselineSpecifications.individualCardsNoReferee: Conditional-on-appearance research baseline using strictly-prior player card/foul exposure only; actual participation and minutes are outcomes, not predictors.

individualCardsConditionalOnAppearance.blocker: Actual participant universe is post-match; role and lineup availability are not timestamp-certified.

sources.fixturesAndRefereeAssignments: UEFA match feed, phase=TOURNAMENT (official person ID, name and country)
